name: Chicken Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta according to package instructions.
Sauté diced chicken and minced garlic in a pan until cooked.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer, then mix in parmesan cheese.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and serve hot.

name: Quick Garlic Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and fry minced garlic until golden brown.
Add scrambled egg and pre-cooked cold rice.
Drizzle soy sauce and stir-fry on high heat for 5 minutes.
